title: Lean core: delete console-subscriber, criterion and sha1 facades; ratchet gawd-swarm ceiling and hermetic hook PATH
goal: Remove three workspace vendor facades (susi-vendor-console-subscriber, susi-vendor-criterion, susi-vendor-sha1) and 60 transitive third-party crates (63 packages total: tonic, prost, console-subscriber, criterion, rayon, plotters, ciborium, flate2, zlib-rs, wasm-bindgen, regex, sha1, etc.) from Cargo.lock and workspace builds, replace STUN HMAC-SHA1 and Git object SHA-1 with pure-std RFC 3174 SHA-1, replace Criterion with a deterministic std benchmark runner, ratchet susi-gawd-swarm line ceiling down by 519 lines, and harden git_publisher_native_hook against ambient PATH push-policy leakage.
host: CachyOS Linux x86_64 (CEO laptop, 28 hardware threads), isolated worktree /home/ramadoss/.cache/carbon-cachyos-distill-20261111/source-agent-carbon-cachyos-distill
acceptance: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi -p susi-daemon-runtime -p susi-core -p susi-gawd-swarm -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --features release-tooling --bin local-release upstream_notices
cargo test --offline --locked --test lean_core_ceilings --test architecture_tests --test orphan_sources --test no_github_coupling --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins
